svg.title: SemiYield four-route results overview
svg.desc: Bilingual dashboard summarising published results and evidence boundaries for manufacturing yield, packaging proxy failure, MOSFET lifetime, and the synthetic three-stage demonstration.

g.text: SemiYield · Results overview / 四线路结果总览
Published aggregate results keep measured evidence, throughput proxy labels and synthetic validation separate.
01 · MANUFACTURING / 制造良率 · measured SECOM evidence
CatBoost repeated CV · 10% inspection capture /复检捕获率 0.269
Boundary / 边界: risk screening, not causal diagnosis /风险筛查，不是因果诊断
02 · PACKAGING / 封测过程 · throughput proxy
Logistic · training-only 10% threshold ·random three-fold internal validation
Boundary / 边界: proxy label; not new-batchgeneralization / 代理标签，非新批次泛化
03 · LIFETIME / 器件寿命 · NASA MOSFET evidence
Weibull β 0.832 · censored survival andstress-temperature analysis
Boundary / 边界: use-temperature result requiresextrapolation validation / 使用温度结果需要外推验证
04 · DEMO / 三阶段演示 · synthetic integration
Batch-isolated flow · packaging logistic PR-AUC0.680 · right censoring
Boundary / 边界: synthetic validation, never anexperimental result / 合成验证，不代表实验结果
Details: reports/verified/ · Methods, source hashes, and aggregate-only static artifacts / 详情：方法、来源哈希与仅聚合静态产物
